decisions.executionNote: Remember left-to-right colors: blue, green, red. Begin elbow-up left approach to the leftmost cover, with open gripper and gradual wrist rotation.
Continue the left elbow-up approach. Align above the left cover while keeping fingers open; blue is the first block to cover.
Lower vertically onto the left cup and close the left gripper. Verify cup retention on the subsequent lift rather than from commanded aperture.
Lift the left cup, keeping its orientation and gripper closed, then move toward the left blue block. Check retention and centering before lowering.
Retained cup visible in left fingers. Center over the blue block, lower without rotating, and release the first cover.
First cover is seated over blue. Withdraw vertically with open fingers, then approach the middle cover without disturbing the covered block.
Align the left gripper over the middle cup, then descend vertically for the second covering step. Keep the blue cover undisturbed.
Correct the stationary right-arm entries; no preceding motion executed. Grasp and lift the middle cover, then advance toward green.
Carry the retained middle cup over green, lower it upright, and open the fingers. Blue remains covered; red is next.
Withdraw from the seated middle cover, keeping the left arm on its side. Begin a mirrored elbow-up approach with the right arm to the last cup.
The left retreat was interrupted by a joint-continuity guard. Replan from the observation with half-sized left increments; continue the right cup approach.
Align the right wrist above the final cup and begin vertical descent. Move the left arm safely back to its own side, keeping both covered blocks undisturbed.
Complete the right-cup descent, close the gripper, and lift vertically. Observe retention before moving it over red.
The right cup is retained. Move over red, lower upright, and release to complete covering in left-to-right order: blue, green, red.
All three covers appear seated. Start uncovering with red only: allow settling, regrasp the right cover, and lift vertically; leave green and blue untouched.
Move the retained red cover back to a clear parking position and release upright. Approach above the middle green cover with the left gripper open, without uncovering it yet.
Red is exposed and its cup is parked. Withdraw the right fingers; align and grasp the middle cover for green, the second uncovering step.
Correct the rejected stationary-right entry; no preceding motion executed. Lift green's cover and move backward while holding closed; blue remains covered.
Park the retained middle cover behind green, lower it upright, and release. Red and green should remain exposed before touching blue.
Withdraw from the parked green cover and approach blue, the last covered block, with the left arm. Begin a gradual elbow-up return of the empty right arm.
Align and descend over the leftmost blue cover with open fingers. Red and green are visible; finish the empty right arm's gradual return toward origin.
Grasp and vertically lift the last cover to uncover blue, after red and green. Keep the cup upright and verify retention visually; settle the right arm at origin.
Blue is visible beneath the retained last cup. Move the cup backward to its clear parking position and lower upright, leaving all three blocks exposed.
Release the last cup at its parking position and withdraw vertically with open fingers. All blocks are exposed; prepare the left arm's continuous elbow-up return to origin.
All cups are parked and all colors visible. Return the empty left arm toward its home waypoint with gradual rotation and continuous elbow-up posture; right stays at origin.
Complete the left arm's gradual return to its initial pose, then settle both open grippers at origin. All blocks remain exposed and cups upright.
